in_marathi.name: सुमित
in_marathi.long_meaning: सुमित हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name सुमित is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sumit’ which means good, auspicious, or well-established. It is also a synonym for the Sanskrit term ‘sumati’, which means ‘wise’, or ‘intelligent’. This name is believed to be auspicious and bestowed upon children to bring good fortune and success in their lives.
